description: Neutralise the dashboard's persisting theme reset: when the per-pack detail fetch fails once (e.g. a client connecting during a gateway restart), useTheme resets the colour theme to the default and writes that to the workspace config, downgrading every client. The reset call after `<installed packs>.has(slug)||` becomes a no-op; the theme heals on the next successful fetch. Structural fingerprint (identifiers vary per build); surface theme.reset-site tracks the same site.
